name: Idiot's Guide to Amestris Alchemy
description: (Tag:magic)(Tag:transformation)(Tome) A guide to Amestris State Military Alchemy covering Transmutation Circles for all basic elements (Water, Earth, Wind, Fire, etc.), activation, and advanced effective use, required reading to use Alchemy. (Note: Excludes human transmutation, Scar's disintegration, and Philosopher Stone creation; only circles previously used by State Alchemists).
